diagnosis_summary: The affected Connections Hub launch path processed a workflow and returned a Workflow Entry URL only when an active entry form existed. Redirect and other interactive actions deliberately wait for Workflow Entry handling during an Obsidian block action, so the workflow could remain parked without a browser destination. Rock closed the issue with commit 5cdcdf797c1c13c564517793cb610d62b3b7d90f, which detects a pending interactive action and routes the user to Workflow Entry for it. The issue is labeled fixed in Rock 19.4; exact package inclusion should still be verified.
workaround_summaries: Use a Rock package proven to contain commit 5cdcdf797c1c13c564517793cb610d62b3b7d90f or an equivalent fix. Before upgrade, do not rely on a Redirect action for a manually launched Connections Hub workflow; use an active entry-form flow or launch from the classic Connection Request Board after staging verification.

verification_playbook.goal: Identify connection workflows that rely on Redirect when manually launched from Connections Hub, without launching or processing a workflow.
prerequisites: Know which workflows are exposed as manual actions in Connections Hub.
Have read-only access to workflow action configuration.

steps.title: Check the installed launch path
steps.instructions: Verify whether Connections Hub still returns only an active Workflow Entry form URL and does not consume Redirect's interactive-action result.
steps.expected_if_affected: The installed path has the reviewed behavior and a launched workflow can complete through Redirect without returning a browser destination.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The installed package contains commit 5cdcdf797c1c13c564517793cb610d62b3b7d90f or an equivalent path that routes pending interactive actions through Workflow Entry.

steps.title: Inspect exposed workflow actions
steps.instructions: Without launching a workflow, inspect each manual Connections Hub workflow and record only whether its reachable action path depends on Redirect before any active entry form.
steps.expected_if_affected: A manually exposed workflow relies on Redirect and the installed hub source does not handle its interactive result.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: No exposed workflow relies on Redirect, an active form is returned first, or the installed hub source handles the redirect result.
evidence_to_record: manual workflow exposed yes or no

limitations: Do not launch a production workflow solely to reproduce the symptom because processing can create activities, logs, notifications, or other side effects.

context.scope: manual single-request workflows launched from Connections Hub that execute Redirect
manual single-request workflows launched from Connections Hub that execute an interactive action
official GitHub fix release line; verify exact package inclusion
